title: Make eve launch and stop the local runtime
summary: Running eve without a subcommand now starts the local runtime with UI, API, HTTP MCP endpoint, browser launcher, and installed macOS approval app launcher. The eve kill command stops the local runtime for the configured localhost port.
userVisibleChange: Users can run eve to start the local EVE experience and eve kill to close the runtime when port 4317 is occupied or no longer needed.

risks.title: eve kill may stop any local process listening on the selected port when no EVE PID file exists.

decisions.title: Preserve eve help as a non-launching help command while making bare eve the launcher.
Keep eve dev as a runtime-only command for development, while making eve the user-facing launcher.
Use a PID file plus a listening-port fallback so eve kill can stop both new runtimes and existing listeners on port 4317.
